items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So it has been like Bobby Rodriguez and Fred Selden

ctx.x: OK. But we are now working on a masters’ degree. Now since Herb Alpert has—how can I say—come into the picture and has provided the funding for all of the music departments if you will, we are now cross-listing a lot of things and the genres are fusing and in the courses of- the courses are fusing. So what we are now doing is creating a masters’ in music with a jazz concentration…

Okay. Burrell:...And we are working on that right now. And, you know, if- I don’t know when we’re going to be dealing with the PhD but right- DMA. There is a DMA in music and some people have gotten there DMAs in performance, and part of that has been jazz. So it has been like Bobby Rodriguez and Fred Selden, (and a) couple other people. Part of their recitals have been jazz pieces. So I think the next step would be—we’re working on it now—is a masters in music with a jazz concentration. And then probably the PhD…
